title: full, shorthand-with-body and zero-field constructors
purpose: Accept the construct and observe its result.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.3: positional call selects the one-parameter full constructor (700); named call selects the shorthand whose body runs after auto-binding (205); `Marker();` is the zero-field shorthand.
